title: Vault 112 Automatic Memory-Carrier Persistence Inference Gate

gate.question: Does Pinkerton's theft of an already-populated Braun mem chip mean that SAVE JAMES should not require a player-visible or MQ04-visible COPY/WRITE/EXPORT command as a necessary condition?
gate.admitted: A memory-to-portable-carrier operation must exist somewhere in the Vault 112/Braun system because Pinkerton physically removed a carrier that already contained an unknown person's memories and later integrated those memories into A3-21.
gate.not_admitted: The shipped evidence does not prove one removable chip per pod, automatic creation of a chip for every session, direct James-to-chip binding, rewritability, or a player-accessible export command.

populated_carrier.finding: Pinkerton says he stole a mem chip from Braun and explicitly says he will not know whose memories are on it until he integrates it into a new host.
populated_carrier.implication: The carrier was already populated before Pinkerton possessed or used it.

successful_destination.finding: Pinkerton reports that he got those memories into A3-21, who then identifies as Harkness and believes himself to be an old combat veteran.
successful_destination.implication: The populated carrier contained causally effective memory state, not merely metadata about a resident.

automation_context.finding: Vault 112 is described as highly automated and requiring only a single administrator, Dr. Stanislaus Braun.
automation_context.implication: A background/system-level persistence path is architecturally compatible with the shipped Vault design and does not require a player-facing manual copy interface.

braun_privilege_context.finding: S. Braun has remote pod privileges and Vault 112 documents per-user memory-access override capability.
braun_privilege_context.implication: Braun controls policy and subject state at a layer above the read-only public terminal surface.

model_comparison.reason_for_change: Pinkerton's successful physical theft of a pre-populated memory carrier demonstrates the output class even though the producing instruction is not exposed in MQ04 or the public terminal UI.

automatic_persistence_hypothesis.hypothesis: Vault 112 or Braun's privileged subsystem may persist subject memory state onto removable media automatically or through an internal service operation rather than through an explicit operator COPY/WRITE action.
supports: pre-populated mem chip physically existed in Braun's custody
the source identity was opaque to Pinkerton before integration
Braun has privileged remote and per-user memory authority
public terminals do not expose the full control plane
limits: no proof that every lounger has a dedicated removable chip
no proof that every session continuously snapshots to a chip
no proof that James's current 2277 session automatically produced a removable chip
no proof that an existing carrier can be rebound or overwritten

still_required: James-specific source persistence or carrier association
evidence that Braun can obtain/select a James-derived payload from the live session or its storage
a removable or transferable carrier containing that James-derived payload

formal_model.existence: EXISTS carrier C: MEMORY_PAYLOAD(C) != EMPTY AND C IN BRAUN_CUSTODY
formal_model.transfer: C -> PINKERTON -> A3_21 produces identity-relevant memory effect
formal_model.inference: there exists an internal Vault112/Braun process P such that P(memory_state) -> populated_carrier
formal_model.not_proven: P is automatic per session OR P(James) was executed OR carrier is rewritable

ru: Пинкертон не создавал memory payload: он физически украл у Braun уже заполненный mem chip, а затем перенёс содержащиеся на нём воспоминания в A3-21.
Поэтому отсутствие COPY/WRITE/EXPORT в MQ04 и публичном терминале не доказывает отсутствия памяти-на-carrier; такой класс операции уже существовал внутри Vault 112/Braun trust domain.

Vault 112 высоко автоматизирован и имеет одного администратора, поэтому внутреннее или автоматическое сохранение памяти на carrier является архитектурно правдоподобнее, чем обязательная ручная команда игрока.
Не доказано, что каждому жителю соответствует отдельный съёмный чип или что James автоматически получил такой carrier в 2277 году.
Следующий поиск должен искать уже существующий James-specific persistence artifact или связь lounger/session с storage, а не обязательную кнопку WRITE.

next_gate.name: JAMES_SESSION_AUTOPERSISTENCE_AND_STORAGE_ASSOCIATION_AUDIT
targets: Search James Lounger #23 and MQ04Doc references for persistent storage or hidden child/linked objects.
Search Braun/Betty privileged scripts for persistence, archive, save-state, memory reset source, reload source or resident-specific storage semantics rather than literal COPY/WRITE terms.
Compare resident monitor anomalies and Pinkerton's unknown-source chip for evidence that carrier identity can become detached from resident identity.
Determine whether Dithers' anomaly is consistent with removal of a resident-associated storage artifact without promoting that old theory absent primary binding.
If a James session-to-storage association is found, promote SAVE JAMES without requiring a user-visible export opcode.
